title: MITS — 100% Digital
hook: A long-term plan to take my old high school fully digital, one system at a time.
text: My old high school. I graduated, and now I am going back — not with a donation, but with a plan: a whole ecosystem of systems that takes MITS fully digital, one building block at a time.
highlights: A multi-system roadmap rather than a single handover.
Unpaid work for the school that shaped me.
Designed to be adopted one building block at a time.

caseStudy.problem: MITS still runs on processes that have never been digitised. A one-off system would not fix that — the school needs a plan it can absorb gradually.
caseStudy.approach: I am treating the school as an ecosystem: identify the building blocks, sequence them so each one stands on its own, and deliver them without disrupting day-to-day operations.
caseStudy.outcome: The roadmap is in progress. Systems are being delivered in stages rather than as a single risky launch.
caseStudy.learned: Charity work needs a plan that survives after you leave. The measure is not what I ship, but what the school can keep running without me.
